title: Exclusive: Grand Theft Auto VI Features Tropical Storms And Hurricanes
summary: Rockstar reveals new details about GTAVI's weather systems in our exclusive cover story. - Game Informer
text: Exclusive: Grand Theft Auto VI Features Tropical Storms And Hurricanes Skip to main content Twitter Facebook Instagram Twitch YouTube TikTok Main navigation Read the Magazine News Reviews Previews Features Videos Podcasts 2026 Release List SUBSCRIBE Search: Type: - Any - Product Preview Review Items per page: 10 20 50 100 Sort by: Most Relevant Oldest first Newest first Follow Us Twitter Facebook Instagram Twitch YouTube Tiktok Share Follow Us Close --> Share Close Post Tweet Email https://gameinformer.com/exclusive/2026/09/29/exclusive-grand-theft-auto-vi-features-tropical-storms-and-hurricanes Copy Link Follow Us Close Twitter Facebook Instagram Twitch YouTube exclusive Exclusive: Grand Theft Auto VI Features Tropical Storms And Hurricanes by Marcus Stewart on Sep 29, 2026 at 12:17 PM Share Facebook Post Twitter Tweet Email Email Comment Comment For our exclusive cover story on Grand Theft Auto VI , Rockstar Games details the game’s advanced weather systems. Designed to simulate the tropical climate of real-life Florida, the game’s setting, Leonida, will feature not only sunny weather but also plenty of the state’s more violent weather phenomena. Rockstar confirms that the game features dynamic cloudscapes that roll across Leonida, creating a broad spectrum of weather from clear skies to cloudy days. The game also features localized storms, meaning you can occupy a dry, sunny area and spot storms in the distance where it is actually pouring down. Drive to that spot after the storm passes, and you’ll be able to tell it just rained thanks to persistent puddles and other wet surfaces. Under the right lighting conditions, you can even spot rainbows following a fresh shower. Florida is known for experiencing tropical storms and seasonal hurricanes; the same is true in Grand Theft Auto VI’s Leonida. While we don’t know how often these larger, more violent storms occur or how they affect gameplay and storytelling, it’s exciting to know they'll be present. To read Rockstar’s full developer details and insights into GTAVI’s weather systems and other game features, be sure to subscribe to read the full cover story .
